data.docs:
**list**: The packet to send, length should match the configured payload_length.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

set_mode_rx.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx126x` mode to rx.

cold.docs:
If true, enter cold sleep instead of warm sleep. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

set_mode_sleep.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx126x` mode to sleep. By default the radio enters warm sleep — config registers are retained so that on wake it is ready for `sx126x.set_mode_rx` / `sx126x.set_mode_tx` again. For battery-powered nodes that pair the radio with deep sleep, `cold: true` switches to cold sleep (~0.6 µA, vs ~600 µA warm). Cold sleep does not retain config, so the radio must be reinitialized on wake. With deep sleep this happens automatically — the device reboots on wake and the component reinitializes the radio during startup.

set_mode_standby.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx126x` mode to standby.

set_mode_tx.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx126x` mode to tx.

bitrate.docs:
**int**: Bit rate of the signal. Normally the inverse of the bit duration, eg 1 / 208 us is 4800 bps.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

coding_rate.docs:
**enum**: Coding rate, values can be `CR_4_5`, `CR_4_6`, `CR_4_7` or `CR_4_8`. Defaults to `CR_4_5`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

crc_enable.docs:
**bool**: Enables a 16 bit CRC calculation/check. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

crc_initial.docs:
**int**: Initial CRC value as a hex integer. Defaults to 0x1D0F.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

crc_inverted.docs:
**bool**: Inverts the CRC if enabled. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

crc_polynomial.docs:
**int**: CRC polynomial as a hex integer. Defaults to 0x1021.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

crc_size.docs:
**int**: Size of the CRC in bytes, either 1 or 2. Defaults to 2.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

deviation.docs:
**frequency**: Transmitter FSK frequency deviation, values range from 0 to 100 kHz. Defaults to `5kHz`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

frequency.docs:
**frequency**: Frequency in Hz of the transceiver.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

on_packet.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a packet has been decoded. Variable x of type `std::vector<uint8_t>` and rssi of type `float` are passed to the automation for use in lambdas. In LoRa mode the variable snr is also available.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

pa_power.docs:
**int**: Transmitter power, range is from -3 to 15 dBm when `hw_version` is `sx1261` and from -3 to 22 dBm otherwise.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

pa_ramp.docs:
**enum**: Transmitter PA ramp, can be `10us`, `20us`, `40us`, `80us`, `200us`, `800us`, `1700us` or `3400us`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

payload_length.docs:
**int**: Length of the packet. Maximum length is 255.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

preamble_detect.docs:
**int**: Minimum length of the preamble in bytes required by the receiver. Preamble detector is disabled if the size is 0 and its value capped at 4.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

preamble_size.docs:
**int**: Length of the preamble in bytes to be sent by the transmitter. This value should be larger than `preamble_detect` on the receive side to allow time for the receiver’s AFC and AGC to adjust.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

rf_switch.docs:
**bool**: Used to indicate if DIO2 controls an external RF switch.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

rx_start.docs:
**bool**: Start the receiver automatically on boot or after transmitting.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

shaping.docs:
**enum**: Transmitter data shaping can be `GAUSSIAN_BT_0_3`, `GAUSSIAN_BT_0_5`, `GAUSSIAN_BT_0_7`, `GAUSSIAN_BT_1_0` or `NONE`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

spreading_factor.docs:
**int**: Spreading factor, values range from 6 to 12. Defaults to 7.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

sync_value.docs:
**list**: Synchronization bytes, list of 1 to 8 bytes, found after the preamble and before the payload.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

tcxo_delay.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time needed for the TCXO to stabilize.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

tcxo_voltage.docs:
**enum**: Reference voltage of the external TCXO controlled by DIO3. If there is no TCXO this should be set to `NONE`. Values can be `1_6V`, `1_7V`, `1_8V`, `2_2V`, `2_4V`, `2_7V`, `3_0V`, `3_3V` or `NONE`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

whitening_enable.docs:
**bool**: Enables CCITT data whitening, with fixed polynomial `0x21`. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*

whitening_initial.docs:
**int**: Initial value of whitening shift register.  Defaults to `0x100`.

*See also: [SX126x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx126x#configuration-variables)*
